about: The user guide's pictures. Read by tools/guide-shots.ps1 (makes them), tools/guide-stale.ps1 (says which are stale) and GuideTests (checks them). Each shot: name (the file name), page (docs/guide/<page>.md, picture in docs/guide/img/<page>/), folder (empty | made-up | none), kind (plain | online | live | kept), address (also tells guide-stale which page's screen it shows), shows (more addresses it ends up on, for guide-stale), waitFor (a selector), steps (walkthrough steps), marks (selectors numbered 1, 2, 3 in the picture), volatile (selectors whose pixels change from run to run), width and height, links (sets of extraModels linked in for its run only), env (environment variables for its run). kind kept = taken by hand and kept (Windows' own windows, the first start's downloads); the script leaves those alone.
